evidenceLimits: Complete relevant families, not the complete dictionary. Omission does not prove absence. Selected senses are non-exhaustive and not independent level assignments. Mapping/source notes are author assertions to assess, not reviewer findings.

rows.mappingNote: New exact source spelling and reading; cooking pot or kettle.
rows.sourceNote: Iron is the raw gloss and a familiar material, not an exceptionless material requirement. Actual encyclopedia definitions support rice-cooking and water-heating vessels made from metal or ceramic; historical origin theories are not adopted.

rows.mappingNote: New exact source spelling and reading; wastepaper or paper scraps.
rows.sourceNote: Recognizes 紙くず without changing the stable source-form ID. Wastepaper does not determine municipal recycling categories or mean every piece of usable paper.

rows.mappingNote: New exact source spelling and reading; respectful deity term and figurative outstanding person.
rows.sourceNote: Native 神 plus respectful 様; 神さま recognized. Does not require monotheism or imply that every expert is literally divine.

rows.mappingNote: New exact source spelling and whole-word reading; shaving razor.
rows.sourceNote: Usually-kana tool sense is taught; カミソリ recognized. Special かみそり reading is not divided into invented character readings. Complete figurative intellect/person senses remain outside the practical tool lesson.

rows.mappingNote: New exact source kana form and reading; chewing gum.
rows.sourceNote: Abbreviation of チューインガム. Other gum/rubber material sense is retained in complete evidence, not silently made the ordinary snack sense or taught as another N2 identity.

rows.mappingNote: New exact source spelling and reading かもつ; cargo/freight.
rows.sourceNote: Cargo need not be merchandise for sale. Complete family preserves alternative かぶつ and money/assets sense without assigning them equal frequency or making them this lesson's focus.

rows.mappingNote: New exact source kana form and reading; itchy.
rows.sourceNote: Recognizes 痒い and usually-kana flag. Alternative かいい remains in complete evidence; adjective describes sensation, not a diagnosis or scratching action.

rows.mappingNote: New exact source spelling and reading; song/ballad.
rows.sourceNote: Song is not restricted to English narrative ballads. Familiar compound 歌謡曲 is explained without equating the whole broad song category with every musical piece.

rows.mappingNote: New exact source spelling and reading; shell, husk or pod.
rows.sourceNote: Physical outer casing examples; no universal shell-versus-skin material boundary is invented. Rare 骸 remains flagged in complete evidence. Same-reading 空/から is a different noun.

rows.mappingNote: New exact source kana form and reading; supplied entry covers color, distinctive character/atmosphere and hair dyeing. Separate clothing-collar entry is taught explicitly.
rows.sourceNote: Color and collar converge on the same Japanese spelling; their English pronunciations do not produce separate Japanese readings. Hair-dyeing sense supports カラーする. Dictionary order is not frequency evidence.
rows.identityNote: Raw gloss bundles collar,color,colour, but supplied principal entry 1038500 contains color-related senses only. Clothing collar belongs to complete separate entry 2853151, recorded as additional teaching rather than silently attributed to 1038500 or assigned an independent N2 level. Botanical homograph 2853152 is retained in comparison evidence but not taught.

source.waller_definition: to ridicule,to tease,to banter with,to make fun of

rows.mappingNote: New exact source kana form and reading; tease, kid or make fun of.
rows.sourceNote: Transitive godan verb with explicit を and からかって/からかわない forms. Playfulness or hurtfulness depends on context; no harmlessness guarantee. Rare 揶揄う is not made the required everyday spelling.

rows.mappingNote: New exact source spelling and reading; empty, vacant or hollow.
rows.sourceNote: Teaches 空っぽだ and 空っぽの箱 without denying the dictionary's na-adjectival classification. Related 空/から differs from primary 空/そら. Small っ is retained.

rows.mappingNote: New exact source kana form and reading; traditional Japanese playing cards and associated game.
rows.sourceNote: Portuguese carta origin is explicit despite hiragana spelling. Source's generic playing-cards gloss is qualified against complete entry's Japanese karuta scope; no claim that every historical card game excludes Western cards. Kana-only reading and rare/search-only written forms remain distinct in evidence.

rows.mappingNote: Reuse existing exact source spelling, reading and explicit plant-withering sense; add sourced N2 level only.
rows.sourceNote: Stable title, reading, kanji array and exclusions remain unchanged. Existing article already teaches source plant sense; no whole-article recertification or new maturity lesson is claimed.

rows.mappingNote: New exact source kana form and reading; calorie.
rows.sourceNote: Food-energy context distinguished from body weight or nutrients themselves. Original food-label example explicitly uses kcal; 1 kcal = 1000 cal is a unit-prefix relation, not individualized dietary advice. FDA food-energy explanation and NIST calorie/prefix definitions are separate receipts, not a claim that FDA text established the capital-Calorie convention.

rows.mappingNote: New exact source kana form and reading; affectionate treatment, favoritism, petting and qualified ironic harsh treatment.
rows.sourceNote: Recognizes 可愛がる and lexical formation from かわいい stem plus がる. Transitive godan, not ichidan; treatment differs from merely describing someone as cute. Colloquial ironic sense is a recognition warning, not a recommended way to treat people.

rows.mappingNote: New exact source spelling and reading; transitive drying.
rows.sourceNote: Explicit contrast 髪を乾かす versus 髪が乾く separates causing drying from becoming dry. Drying can use a dryer or other means; it is not restricted to hanging out laundry. Reciprocal primary 乾 link supplied.

rows.mappingNote: New exact source spelling and reading; be thirsty and figuratively thirst/crave.
rows.sourceNote: Godan intransitive verb. 喉が渇く is the teaching spelling; complete comparison family 1277350 also recognizes 喉が乾く, so the related 乾く article's old absolute prohibition is narrowly qualified. Figurative Nに渇く differs from ordinary drying.

rows.mappingNote: New exact source spelling and whole-word reading かわせ; financial exchange and money order/draft.
rows.sourceNote: Separate meanings are not general barter or a document draft. Financial exchange includes domestic settlement, not only converting foreign cash. Complete family preserves obsolete かわし with its flag; 替 receives a whole-word reciprocal example without invented component readings.

rows.mappingNote: New exact source spelling and reading; tile, especially a roof tile.
rows.sourceNote: 瓦 is not the entire roof and does not name every modern building material. No universal clay-only material rule or unsupported history is introduced; the written character remains in metadata despite lacking a kanji card.

actualEntryInspections.source: Revised World Encyclopedia and Nipponica (宮本瑞夫) on Kotobank
actualEntryInspections.location: Actual cooking/rice/water-heating vessel definitions and metal/ceramic material descriptions.
actualEntryInspections.observation: A rice-cooking or water-heating vessel need not invariably be iron; the compact source gloss is a prototype, not an exceptionless material restriction.
actualEntryInspections.limits: Daijisen and Jitsu sections provided headings, not inspected definitions. Competing historical etymologies, prevalence and manufacturing details are not adopted.

actualEntryInspections.source: Seisenban Nihon Kokugo Daijiten on Kotobank
actualEntryInspections.location: Actual respectful-deity, godlike-character and superior-ability definitions.
actualEntryInspections.observation: Supports both religious respect and figurative praise of someone outstanding in a field.
actualEntryInspections.limits: Daijisen heading alone is not definition verification. Japanese source numbering is not substituted for JMdict indices; no theology or academic degree is inferred.

actualEntryInspections.source: Digital Daijisen and Seisenban Nihon Kokugo Daijiten on Kotobank
actualEntryInspections.location: Actual affectionate-treatment, favoritism and ironic rough-treatment definitions; Seisenban formation note.
actualEntryInspections.observation: Supports lexical treatment, the かわいい stem plus がる formation, and contextual irony rather than mere appearance of cuteness.
actualEntryInspections.limits: Petting/caressing sense 3 is separately grounded in the complete pinned JMdict entry. Historical かわゆがる and かあいがる entries are not made modern primary readings. Ironic harshness is recognition guidance, not recommended behavior.

actualEntryInspections.source: Nipponica explanation by 斎藤良輔 on Kotobank
actualEntryInspections.location: Actual card/game explanation, Portuguese carta origin and Japanese/Western historical branches.
actualEntryInspections.observation: Supports the loanword despite hiragana spelling and a practical traditional-Japanese-card lesson without denying historically broader card uses.
actualEntryInspections.limits: Not a universal rulebook for every karuta game or a claim that かるた has never included Western cards. Rare and search-only spellings remain separately flagged in the pinned family.

actualEntryInspections.location: Actual thirst and intense-desire definitions, including 愛に渇く.
actualEntryInspections.observation: Supports literal thirst and figurative Nに渇く rather than an unrestricted wet/dry replacement.
actualEntryInspections.limits: The source's example supports the construction, not corpus attestation of the newly authored sentence. It does not establish an absolute ban on all 乾 throat spellings.

actualEntryInspections.source: Seisenban Nihon Kokugo Daijiten on Kotobank
actualEntryInspections.observation: Qualifies an absolute division of written forms; complete pinned phrase entry 1277350 specifically records 喉が乾く alongside 喉が渇く.
actualEntryInspections.limits: Daijisen heading alone is not definition verification. Historical examples do not make every modern spelling freely interchangeable.

actualEntryInspections.source: Revised World Encyclopedia explanation by 永易秀夫 on Kotobank
actualEntryInspections.location: Actual modern-heading explanation of distant settlement without transporting cash, domestic/foreign types and differing currencies.
actualEntryInspections.observation: Financial exchange is broader than changing foreign notes over a counter; supports the distinction from ordinary object exchange.
actualEntryInspections.limits: Opening lexical sections concern historical かわし, not modern かわせ verification. No current banking-service rules, fees or availability are inferred from the historical prose.

actualEntryInspections.source: U.S. Food and Drug Administration nutrition-label guide
actualEntryInspections.location: Actual sections 1-2 on serving amounts and calories as food energy.
actualEntryInspections.observation: Supports food-energy context and the difference between a stated serving and the whole package.
actualEntryInspections.limits: Not evidence of Japanese nutritional-label law or individualized dietary advice. The inspected text did not explicitly establish the capital-C nutritional-Calorie convention; the card does not assert that convention.

actualEntryInspections.location: Actual section 5.3.2 and Table 11, thermochemical calorie.
actualEntryInspections.observation: Defines a calorie as an energy unit (thermochemical 1 cal = 4.184 J) and treats it as non-SI.
actualEntryInspections.limits: The card does not teach all calorie conventions, make calorie an SI unit, or infer nutritional Calorie = kcal solely from this passage.

actualEntryInspections.headword: Decimal multiples and submultiples; SI prefixes
actualEntryInspections.location: Actual section 4.3 and Table 5, inspected through the kilo row and note.
actualEntryInspections.observation: Kilo (k) denotes 10^3, or 1000; applying the prefix to cal establishes the unit relation 1 kcal = 1000 cal.
actualEntryInspections.limits: The initial partial fetch ended before the prefix section; subsequent actual retrieval supplied section 4.3 and the table. No outdated base-unit definitions or exhaustive prefix lesson are adopted.

quizGuardRationale: Pairs are declared on new articles only, direct and symmetric rather than transitive. Baseline lists remain unchanged. Their justification is overlapping quiz labels, not unrestricted Japanese substitution.
釜/鍋 protects the overlapping cooking-pot label while retaining vessel-specific collocations.
紙屑 protects paper, rubbish and the unqualified English waste label. The material and wastefulness distinction remains explicit; no municipal sorting rule is inferred.
神様 protects the deity label and actual outstanding-person/expert meanings of 神, 名人, 博士 and 人物; no academic degree is inferred from praise.
貨物 protects actual goods, merchandise and luggage/package labels. Broad 物 was inspected but not declared merely because all freight consists of things.
かゆい/むずむず protects the actual itch sensation. ぽりぽり describes scratching and is not automatically the same state.
歌謡 protects song/piece-of-music and the unqualified music label. Vocal songs remain distinguishable from instrumental pieces and the entire art of music.
殻 protects shell and actual outer-covering labels, including ambiguous unmarked English cover. This does not make a book cover a natural 殻 collocation or collapse noun and verb argument structures.

カラー protects the color, character/characteristic and atmosphere labels, including English atmosphere ambiguity with physical 大気. Individual named colors were inspected as candidates but not declared merely because they are members of the color category; 紅茶 is not a color synonym because its title contains black.
からかう protects teasing, joking, ridicule/laugh-at and insulting-remark labels. An unkind context is possible, but harmlessness and sustained bullying are not universal implications.

空っぽ protects actual emptiness/hollowness, available-space and become-vacant labels across grammatical viewpoints. 空's primary sky reading does not erase its explicitly taught separate から empty identity.
かるた protects generic card and playing-card labels without equating traditional karuta with every Western card game.
カロリー protects food energy and the unqualified energy label on 活力; the lesson explicitly distinguishes an energy unit/content from vitality and does not equate the technical quantities.
かわいがる protects affection/loving/liking labels and the explicitly taught ironic rough-treatment overlap with いじめる. Looking cute alone is a contrast, not an exclusion from かわいい.
乾かす protects drying/airing and causing-dryness labels. The explicit dry something versus become dry titles distinguish its argument role from 乾く; no broad dry-state mimetic clique is declared.
渇く protects parched/thirsty and desire labels, including the recorded 乾 throat spelling. Figurative Nに渇く does not inherit the grammar of 欲しい or 望む.

為替 protects money-exchange and exchange/change labels, respecting nonexclusive spelling tendencies for 換える/替える. 案 protects unmarked English draft ambiguity, not a Japanese equivalence between financial instruments and a proposed text.
瓦/屋根 is a part/whole navigation comparison, not a declared synonym pair. 剃刀/ナイフ distinguishes a razor from a general knife; no pair is inferred only from their having blades.
sourceAccessLimits: Inspection receipts record author access, not independent reviewer retrieval. Search summaries, irrelevant search pages, failed 404/504 requests and heading-only sections are not definition verification.

The raw カラー gloss bundles collar and color. Supplied 1038500 is the color family; complete 2853151 supplies separately recorded additional collar teaching without an independently inferred N2 assignment. Calla-lily homograph 2853152 remains evidence, not an extra lesson.
Nineteen new articles and level-only reuse of 枯れる for explicit plant sense 1. Reuse does not imply whole-card recertification or teaching of maturity sense 2.
Three new primary-form reciprocal N2 pairs: 貨/貨物, 乾/乾かす and 替/為替. 枯/枯れる was already linked.
剃, 刀, 屑, 殻, 渇, 為, 瓦, 謡 and 釜 lack character cards. Primary written characters remain in metadata; no speculative character/stroke additions or invented component readings.

Related existing 乾く teaching is narrowly corrected so 喉が乾く is not absolutely forbidden; 乾 carries the matching qualified comparison. 干す, 色 and いじめる gain navigation links only. Baseline word IDs, primary readings, titles, easier levels and original exclusion lists are preserved.

Complete families retain unselected readings, specialist/historical uses and flags. Dictionary order or missing priority does not establish measured frequency. Search-only forms are not promoted to ordinary alternatives.

Original examples are authored teaching sentences, not independently corpus-attested quotations. Structural validation is not linguistic certification. Exact source scope does not establish an official JLPT syllabus.
